quote: We evaluate our unstructured pruning framework on Mamba models across diverse tasks, including language modeling, long-range understanding, and time-series forecasting, using benchmark datasets such as WikiText-103, Long Range Arena, and ETT.

Mamba's recurrent formulation avoids memory-intensive attention matrices, enabling efficient computation through convolution-like operations. This favorable scaling has spurred extensions to vision , multimodal processing , and genomics . Despite these advances, deploying Mamba models in resource-constrained environments remains challenging due to their millions of parameters .
